findings.message: PR5-E1: CodexRuntimeAdapter.liveness fully implemented. Reads threads.updated_at (Unix seconds) and threads.archived from ~/.codex/state_5.sqlite via read-only URI. Tails ~/.codex/history.jsonl (last 200 lines) for most recent ts per session_id. Uses max(updated_at, history_ts) as activity signal. Gracefully returns idle on any failure.

PR5-E2: Pricing audit complete. compute_cost is never called for Codex rows. CodexRuntimeAdapter.enrich_row sets cumulative_cost_usd=None directly. TelemetryService._backfill_costs naturally skips Codex events (OpenAI model names absent from PRICING_TABLE). No defensive guard in pricing.py needed.

Schema discovery: threads.id (TEXT PK), updated_at (INTEGER Unix seconds), archived (INTEGER 0/1). updated_at_ms column also exists (milliseconds) but unused — consistent with history.jsonl ts which is also Unix seconds.
Live smoke test: adapter.liveness('fake-id', '/tmp') returns idle (graceful degradation). Live threads from operator ~/.codex/state_5.sqlite all classified as ended (old sessions).
